task_definition.task_description: Please check Bitcoin’s price and save a note titled “Crypto market snapshot” with “Bitcoin” in it, then scan my living room devices, identify the smart lock, check the living room light status, and set that light’s brightness to 70. After that, find trending alternatives to the Sony WH-1000XM5 for alice, pick the recommendation that can cover a quantity of 2, place 2 units on hold, confirm the order, get the current UTC time, email alice that it’s confirmed, and then set the living room AC to eco mode at 22.5°C.

user_input.query: Please check the price of BTC and save a note titled “Crypto market snapshot” that includes Bitcoin. Then scan my living_room devices, identify the smart lock, check the status of light_living, and set its brightness to 70. After that, for user_id alice, find trending alternatives in the electronics category to product_id p_sony_xm5_blk, choose a recommendation that can fulfill quantity 2, place 2 units on hold, and confirm the order using paypal. Once that’s done, get the current time in UTC, email alice that it’s confirmed, and finally set thermostat_device_id ac_living in the living_room to hvac_mode eco at 22.5°C.
